local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer() local unit = UnitManager.GetUnit(me, 0) if unit == nil then print("ERR:UNIT_NOT_FOUND"); print("---END---"); return end
local hp = unit:GetMaxDamage() - unit:GetDamage()
local maxHP = unit:GetMaxDamage()
if hp >= maxHP then print("ERR:FULL_HP|Unit already at full health (" .. hp .. "/" .. maxHP .. ")"); print("---END---"); return end
local healHash = GameInfo.UnitOperations["UNITOPERATION_HEAL"].Hash
if UnitManager.CanStartOperation(unit, healHash, nil, nil) then
    UnitManager.RequestOperation(unit, healHash, {})
    print("OK:HEALING|HP:" .. hp .. "/" .. maxHP)
else
    print("ERR:CANNOT_HEAL|Unit cannot fortify-until-healed"); print("---END---"); return
end
print("---END---")
